title: Attach full provenance fields and enforce reads (VC-201-081)
goal: VC-201-081 refuted: Provenance has only source/recorded_unix/retention_secs — no workspace, receipt, revision, classification, or owner fields exist to attach; source is a self-declared string so a model assertion can claim 'user'; expired() is an advisory predicate — there is no read path and no authorization check; retention_secs=0 makes records born-expired; nothing calls it outside tests. Evidence: crates/susi-core/src/tests/vc_201_081_mastery.rs.
